cards.mood: The piece opens with a cold, atmospheric tension that quickly erupts into aggressive, high-energy intensity.
cards.palette: Heavily distorted, down-tuned electric guitars serve as the core harmonic and rhythmic engine, present from the first heavy bar to the end.

cards.mood: The piece opens with a tense, atmospheric build-up that quickly erupts into high-octane aggression and urgency.
cards.palette: Heavily distorted, down-tuned electric guitars provide the core harmonic and rhythmic drive, utilizing palm-muted chugging patterns in the verses and open, soaring power chords in the choruses.
